description: This file defines the HibernatePatientDAO class which implements data access methods for Patient entities in the OpenMRS system using Hibernate ORM. It includes CRUD operations, complex search functions, and associations with other entities like allergies and identifiers.

classes.name: HibernatePatientDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of the PatientDAO interface, providing CRUD and search functionalities for Patient entities.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient by internal ID.

methods.name: savePatient
methods.description: Creates or updates a Patient record in the database.

methods.name: isIdentifierInUseByAnotherPatient
methods.description: Checks if a given PatientIdentifier is already used by a different patient.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientIdentifier by its ID.

methods.name: savePatientIdentifier
methods.description: Creates or updates a PatientIdentifier in the database.

methods.name: deletePatient
methods.description: Deletes a Patient and associated data.

methods.name: getAllergies
methods.description: Fetches all allergies associated with a patient.

methods.name: getAllergyStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the allergy status string for a patient.

methods.name: saveAllergies
methods.description: Saves allergy information for a patient.

methods.name: getAllergy
methods.description: Retrieves an Allergy entity by ID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierByProgram
methods.description: Retrieves PatientIdentifiers associated with a specific PatientProgram.
